why_not_llm.title: General-purpose AI predicts the next word. AssureProof proves the math.
why_not_llm.sub: ChatGPT and Claude are built to sound plausible, not to guarantee mathematical consistency across a 300-page document stack. When a missed clause or billing overage costs thousands of dollars, probability is not enough.
why_not_llm.table.rows.core_engine.llm: Probabilistic — guesses the most likely text based on patterns.
why_not_llm.table.rows.core_engine.assur: Deterministic — mathematically tests every figure and rule using a formal logic solver.
why_not_llm.table.rows.math.llm: Often misses subtle discrepancies or loses accuracy as file length grows ("lost in the middle").
why_not_llm.table.rows.math.assure: A formal logic solver checks whether every figure, clause, and citation can all be true at the same time. A contradiction stops export.
why_not_llm.table.rows.traceability.llm: Citations can be vague, paraphrased, or fabricated.
why_not_llm.table.rows.traceability.assu: Every claim is pinned directly to the exact source document, page, and line.
why_not_llm.table.rows.conflict_handling: Quietly smooths over contradictions to give you a polite, confident answer.
Automatically locks export upon disagreement, forcing a human decision.
why_not_llm.table.rows.audit.llm: No built-in approval gates or cryptographic audit log of who overrode a discrepancy.
why_not_llm.table.rows.audit.assure: Full governance trail recording every flagged conflict, reviewer sign-off, and override.
why_not_llm.table.rows.residency.llm: Prompts and files typically pass through third-party cloud APIs.
why_not_llm.table.rows.residency.assure: Runs 100% inside your AWS account, private GPU, or air-gapped on-prem server.

about.checks.1: Assure reads every document and keeps each figure tied to its source page. A language model then writes the draft. A formal consistency checker then tests whether the draft's figures and the values locked from the source can all be true at the same time. For a labeled figure, the language model does not make that call. For a sentence with no label, the language model turns it into a numeric comparison, and the formal consistency checker tests whether it holds. When a file is first read, the formal consistency checker can also flag figures in that file that contradict each other.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: AssureProof reads your contracts, invoices, claims and bids together and marks every figure that does not match across them, with both source pages open. A person reviews each flag and decides. It runs in your own AWS account or on your own servers, including air-gapped networks.
faq.a2: Z3 is a formal logic solver (SMT solver) that mathematically proves whether a set of figures and constraints can all be true at the same time. It gives a deterministic yes/no answer — no probability, no hallucination.
faq.a3: The same inputs always produce the same output. There is no randomness, no temperature setting, and no model drift. If the figures conflict today, they will conflict tomorrow.
faq.a4: An optional, separate adversarial pass where a language model tries to find flaws in the draft — missing citations, overstated claims, or numbers that do not trace back to a source page. It runs only when requested.
faq.a5: Yes. Export is automatically locked while any contradiction is unresolved. A person (or an authorized agent) must accept or reject each finding before the file can be downloaded. The file stays downloadable the entire time — you just cannot export a conflicted version.
faq.a6: In your own AWS account (using Amazon Bedrock), on a private GPU, or on your own on-premises servers — including air-gapped networks. You choose the deployment model; documents never leave your boundary unless you connect an external endpoint yourself.
privacy.enterprise.body_html:
Assure (“we,” “our,” or “us”) operates the assureproof.com website. This policy covers only this website.

1. What Data This Website Collects

a. What the website itself does

assureproof.com serves static pages. Assure keeps the source page with every figure and shows the contradiction before you pay. A person decides. The file can still be downloaded. Runs in your own AWS account, on-premises, or private GPU environment. You choose where the models run. Your language preference is stored in your browser (localStorage), not on our servers.

b. Demo and contact requests

The contact and demo form sends your name, work email, company, and message by email to our sales team. We use them only to reply to you and arrange a demo. If you email us directly, we process your email address and your message for the same purpose.

We do not use your data to train models. We do not sell or share your data for advertising or marketing.

2. How We Use Your Data

DataPurpose
Demo and contact requestsTo reply to you and arrange the demo you asked for.
Email you send usTo answer your question.

We use your data for nothing else.

3. Sharing Your Data

We do not sell your data and we do not share it with advertisers.

In self-hosted, private-GPU, and air-gapped deployments, and when using Amazon Bedrock inside your own AWS account, your documents and results are not transferred outside your environment by us. The only exception is a model or service endpoint that you choose to connect yourself, which is governed by that provider's policies.

4. Your Rights

Depending on your jurisdiction (including GDPR and CCPA), you may have the following rights:

RightHow to Exercise
AccessRequest a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
RectificationRequest correction of inaccurate personal data.
ErasureRequest deletion of your data.
Data PortabilityRequest a machine-readable copy of your data.
Object / Restrict ProcessingObject to certain types of processing.

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at: privacy@getassureai.com

5. Data Security

  • Your request travels over TLS.
  • Demo and contact emails are stored in our email systems, with access limited to the team that answers them.
  • This website has no customer database.

6. Data Retention

We keep demo and contact emails only as long as needed to handle your request, then delete them, unless the law requires us to keep them longer.

7. Children’s Privacy

This website is not directed at individuals under 16. We do not knowingly collect their personal data. If you believe a child sent us their data, contact us and we will delete it.

8. Disclaimer: Verification Is a Filter, Not a Promise of Accuracy

Reading and drafting use language models, so extracted text and drafted wording can occasionally be wrong. The figure check itself is deterministic: the same figures and rules give the same answer every time. Verification is a filter, not a promise of accuracy. We make no promise that output is flawless, complete, or free from errors. Independently verify critical information. Output can be wrong. Every figure keeps its source page so you can check it yourself, and neither a flagged nor an unflagged figure is a substitute for your own review. You check the result before you use it in a client, a paper, or a decision.

9. Data Processing Terms

Enterprise deployments include data processing terms in the signed enterprise agreement. To request a copy of our data processing terms, write to privacy@getassureai.com.

10. International Transfers

In self-hosted, private-GPU, and air-gapped deployments, and when using Amazon Bedrock inside your own AWS account, we do not transfer your documents or results outside your environment. Transfers occur only to a model or service endpoint that you have chosen to connect, which is governed by that provider's policies.

11. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy. The current version is always on this page. We announce material changes on this page or by email.

12. Contact Us

Questions about this policy or your data:

Email: privacy@getassureai.com
